# apim_portal_theme (Resource)

PortalTheme Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_portal_theme" "brand" {
  hrid = "brand-theme"
  name = "Brand theme"
  definition = {
    font = { font_family = "Arial, sans-serif" }
    color = {
      primary    = "#146b50"
      secondary  = "#344256"
      background = { page = "#ffffff", card = "#f2f4f6" }
    }
  }
}

resource "apim_portal" "developer-portal" {
  hrid              = "developer-portal"
  name              = "Developer Portal"
  structure         = { top_navbar = [] }
  active_theme_hrid = apim_portal_theme.brand.hrid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (Attributes) Visual definition of a next-gen portal Theme. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the theme

### Optional

- `background_image` (String) Hero / landing page background image. Same inline data URI convention as `logo`.
- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `favicon` (String) Browser tab icon. Same inline data URI convention as `logo`.
- `logo` (String) Primary logo. Inline data URI (for example `data:image/png;base64,...`), the same shape the
console produces on upload.
- `optional_logo` (String) Alternate logo for contexts where the primary one does not render well (dark background, small badge, etc.).
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

- `font` (Attributes) Typography settings for a next-gen portal Theme. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--font))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_portal_theme.brand
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "brand-theme"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_portal_theme.brand '{"environment_id":"DEFAULT","hrid":"brand-theme","organization_id":"DEFAULT"}'
```
